claims.statement: ConcurrentBCR2 is two A4V BCR conjunctions on one P/I/K/event/target binding, with simultaneous activity and distinct live anchor/route roles; overlap is allowed.

counterexamples: two available but not simultaneous schemas

claims.statement: After two one-bit XOR bearer-centred local decoders, exactly four of sixteen Boolean mergers recover the target on all eight target/anchor worlds: two projections and two symmetric two-input mergers.
claims.domain: All deterministic Boolean h:{0,1}^2->{0,1} after the declared two-route witness.
claims.proof_or_source: Diagonal truth-table proof in MODEL_PROOF.md and exhaustive check_overlapping_centres.py output.
counterexamples: No automatic extension to noisy, multibit, continuous, or physical systems

claims.statement: ConcurrentBCR2 does not entail that both local routes organize the same named downstream target.
